I don't think it's about what can be done by mods, although I agree that there should be better ways (working links) to keep the mods informed of things. In a situation like this, it is the user such as yourself who defines what happens. You should either choose to engage the person if you feel there is a true threat to the person's well being and you care, or you choose to believe it is attention seeking and ignore it or call them out. The main point is it is the community's responsibility to handle something that they deem harmful if they see it. The mods have no more power than you do to address a suicidal person. If it bothers you, engage and help, even call attention to it by linking to the post and asking other users for help. Don't expect the mods to handle it and you get to feel better when you don't even know if the person is seriously asking for help or just looking for attention.
